description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for storing and querying Large Language Model (LLM) cost records in a MongoDB database. It includes schema definitions, indexes for efficient filtering, and a pre-update hook.

classes.name: LLMCostsSchema
classes.description: Mongoose schema for LLM cost records, including fields for task, session, tenant, project, user, model, provider, service, operation, cost details, and timestamps.

classes.name: CostBreakdownSchema
classes.description: Sub-schema for flexible cost component key-value pairs, allowing varied cost record structures.

methods.name: pre('findOneAndUpdate')
methods.description: Pre-hook to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp before executing a findOneAndUpdate operation.
